correct_query: SELECT s.shipping_cost FROM orders AS o INNER JOIN shipments AS s ON o.customer_id = s.customer_id ORDER BY o.total_amount DESC, s.shipped_date ASC, o.order_id NULLS LAST, s.shipment_id NULLS LAST LIMIT 1

expected_semantic_errors_to_be_caught.description: Mutant replaces ORDER BY o.total_amount DESC LIMIT 1 over the joined tables with a global WHERE o.total_amount = (SELECT MAX(total_amount) FROM orders) filter, which fails when the order with the maximum total_amount has no matching rows in shipments
expected_semantic_errors_to_be_caught.query: SELECT s.shipping_cost FROM orders AS o JOIN customers AS c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN shipments AS s ON c.customer_id = s.customer_id WHERE o.total_amount = (SELECT MAX(total_amount) FROM orders) ORDER BY s.shipped_date ASC, o.order_id NULLS LAST, c.customer_id NULLS LAST, s.shipment_id NULLS LAST LIMIT 1
